title: Interactive 3D Model Viewer
subtitle: Web-based AR-ready asset preview with Model Viewer
challenge: Built a lightweight web viewer around Google Model Viewer to host AR-ready USDZ content and external GLTF/GLB assets with responsive controls and polished visual design.
architecture: Component-based viewer layout with declarative HTML, CSS layering, and reusable AR-ready model cards.
codeSnippet:
<model-viewer
  src="https://modelviewer.dev/shared-assets/models/Astronaut.glb"
  ios-src="./testObj.usdz"
  alt="Astronaut 3D Model"
  auto-rotate
  camera-controls
  ar
  shadow-intensity="1.2"
  environment-image="neutral"
></model-viewer>
